maintenance: Use focused crops of real product screenshots. Retain control labels and values; do not paint over or recreate UI. Exclude cursors, OS window frames, unrelated panels, credentials, and private overlay URLs. Store real PNG files and serve without lossy recompression or upscaling.
editorialDecisions: Twitch's current guide says dual format is available to all streamers; removed the older SE.Live article's Twitch beta-access requirement and OBS 31 rollback advice.

Retained SE.Live Public Beta as a setup prerequisite and Aitum incompatibility based on the SE.Live dual-format article. The installed build exposes the required controls, but this does not establish stable-channel availability.
Canvas support prose says OK while its creation screenshot says ADD; use 'Confirm to create the canvas' rather than a mismatched button label.
Scene-link instructions describe the direction explicitly supported by the article: selecting a canvas scene changes its linked OBS scene.
Removed source-comparison prose from end-user pages; kept relevant help links.
Twitch dual format explicitly requires OBS 32.0.0 or newer, as listed by Twitch.

macOS beta support confirmed by Jacob in this task on 2026-09-13, consistent with the product page. The Windows-only statement in the support article is stale. Installation documents both platforms; OBS 31+ is stated for Windows only.
